desc.zh: 对现实世界的一次采样记录；采样的方式（谁、何时、哪些字段）决定了后续能问什么问题。
desc.en: A sampled record of reality; how you sample (who, when, which fields) decides what you can ask later.

desc.zh: 数据 → 信息 → 知识 → 智慧 的四层模型：越往上越有价值，样本越少，越依赖人的判断。
desc.en: Data → Information → Knowledge → Wisdom: higher tiers are more valuable, smaller in volume, and more dependent on judgement.

desc.zh: 常用四个维度衡量：完整性、准确性、一致性、时效性。
desc.en: Usually measured on four dimensions: completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness.

desc.zh: 名义 / 序数 / 区间 / 比率四类，决定数据允许做哪些运算（例如名义数据不能求平均）。
desc.en: Nominal / ordinal / interval / ratio; they decide which operations are legal (e.g. nominal data cannot be averaged).

desc.zh: 用来编码数据的视觉属性，如位置、长度、角度、面积、亮度、色相、形状。
desc.en: A visual property used to encode data: position, length, angle, area, brightness, hue, shape.

desc.zh: 把数据字段映射到视觉通道的过程；映射是否合适直接决定图能不能读。
desc.en: The process of mapping data fields to visual channels; a poor mapping makes a chart unreadable.

desc.zh: 在不改变含义的前提下重塑数据：过滤、映射、排序、分组、聚合。
desc.en: Reshaping data without changing its meaning: filter, map, sort, group, aggregate.

desc.zh: D3 把数据数组与 DOM 元素配对的过程，结果为 enter / update / exit 三态。
desc.en: D3 pairing a data array with DOM nodes, producing the enter / update / exit triad.

desc.zh: 原数据 → 数据表 → 视觉结构 → 视图 的三段流水线，每段输入输出都有明确类型。
desc.en: Raw data → data table → visual structure → view: a three-stage pipeline with typed inputs and outputs.

desc.zh: 概览优先、缩放过滤、按需细节——交互设计的默认骨架。
desc.en: Overview first, zoom and filter, then details on demand — the default interaction skeleton.

desc.zh: 让树既紧凑又不重叠的经典层级布局算法。
desc.en: The classic hierarchical layout that keeps a tree compact without overlaps.

desc.zh: 把监听器绑在父节点上，靠事件冒泡接住子元素事件；比逐个元素绑定更稳。
desc.en: Attaching one listener to a parent and letting bubbling catch child events; steadier than per-element listeners.

desc.zh: 颜色的坐标系统。RGB 用于存储显示、HSL 便于人工描述、Lab 用于感知评估。
desc.en: A coordinate system for color. RGB for storage/display, HSL for human description, Lab for perception.

desc.zh: 颜色空间中相等的距离对应人眼感觉到的相等差异；判据是亮度单调变化。
desc.en: Equal distances in the space correspond to equal perceived differences; the practical test is monotonic lightness.

desc.zh: 把数值映射到颜色的函数/色标，分顺序型、发散型、定性型三类。
desc.en: A function mapping values to colors, in three families: sequential, diverging, categorical.

desc.zh: 同类 / 邻近 / 互补 / 分裂互补 / 三角，用于让一组颜色「看起来是一套」。
desc.en: Monochromatic / analogous / complementary / split-complementary / triadic — making colors look like one family.

desc.zh: 约 8% 男性存在某种色觉缺陷；配色必须提供冗余编码（形状、标注、明暗差）。
desc.en: Roughly 8% of men have some deficiency; palettes must provide a redundant encoding.

desc.zh: 数据空间 → 坐标系空间 → 屏幕空间的三层换算过程。
desc.en: The three-layer conversion from data space to coordinate space to screen space.

desc.zh: D3 的比例尺函数，负责 domain（数据范围）到 range（视觉范围）的映射。
desc.en: D3’s scale functions, mapping a domain (data extent) to a range (visual extent).

desc.zh: 把离散点连成线的规则；越平滑越可能与真实数据不符。
desc.en: The rule joining discrete points; the smoother it is, the more it may deviate from the data.

desc.zh: 折线的平均斜率接近 45° 时，人判断幅度差异最准确。
desc.en: Lines whose average slope is near 45° are judged most accurately for magnitude.

desc.zh: 把数值相同的点连成的线；本质是在网格边上找内外交界再连线。
desc.en: A line joining equal values; essentially edge crossings per grid cell, joined together.

desc.zh: 有序、连续、周期、独立于空间、结构性——五个属性决定时间序列的画法。
desc.en: Ordered, continuous, periodic, space-independent, structured — five attributes that pick the idiom.

desc.zh: 两个轴都放时间的图表（如周 × 星期几），擅长呈现周期性。
desc.en: A chart where both axes carry time (e.g. week × weekday), strong at periodicity.

desc.zh: 把时间卷成螺旋，让周期头尾相接；需要区分不同圈次。
desc.en: Wrapping time into a spiral so cycles meet head to tail; turns must be distinguished.

desc.zh: 用实体线 + 事件 + 时间讲关系随时间变化的叙事型可视化。
desc.en: A narrative visualization using entity lines, events and time to show changing relationships.

desc.zh: 按日 / 周 / 月 / 年聚合时间数据；换粒度等于换要回答的问题。
desc.en: Aggregating time by day / week / month / year; changing granularity changes the question.

desc.zh: 用视觉通道表达数据，以增强人的认知与判断；不是"把数据画出来"这么简单。
desc.en: Expressing data through visual channels to aid human cognition — more than "just drawing the data".

desc.zh: 数据流模型的第三站：图元（marks）与通道映射的组合。
desc.en: The third station of the data-flow model: marks plus channel mappings.

desc.zh: 图中承载数据的基本图形，如点、线、矩形、区域。
desc.en: The basic graphical element carrying data: point, line, rectangle, area.

desc.zh: 数据流模型的第二站，是可视化真正操作的对象（行 × 列）。
desc.en: The second station of the data-flow model; the table (rows × columns) visualization actually works on.
